func TestNoConstantConditionPort(t *testing.T) {
    t.Parallel()
    oracle := goOracle(t)
    directory := mutant(t, "", "")
    var rows []string
    count := 0
    for _, row := range upstream(t) {
        fields := strings.Split(row, "\t")
        if len(fields)>1 && fields[1]=="no-constant-condition" { rows=append(rows,row); count++ }
    }
    t.Logf("no-constant-condition upstream cases: %d",count)
    for _, d := range prepareRegistry(t,".") {
        if d.Name == "no-constant-condition" { rows=append(rows,ownedWitnessRows(t,".",d)...); }
    }
    for _, row := range generated(t) {
        fields := strings.Split(row,"\t")
        if len(fields)==1 || fields[1]=="all" || fields[1]=="no-constant-condition" { rows=append(rows,row) }
    }
    compare(t,oracle,buildPort(t,directory,true),directory,manifest(t,rows))
}
